title: Decide: TensorZero extension fields — metadata.tensorzero.* vs tensorzero_*
description:
Decide how to surface TensorZero-specific extension fields (`episode_id`, `variant_name`, `tags`, `cache_options`, `extra_body`, `extra_headers`, `dryrun`) on the Anthropic ingress request body.

## Options

- **`metadata.tensorzero.*`** namespaced under Anthropic's first-class `metadata` field (Anthropic's natural extension point, passed through verbatim by the SDK).
- **Top-level `tensorzero_*`** fields using `allow_extra_fields` — mirrors how OpenAI-compat ingress lifts `tensorzero::*` fields.

## Recommendation

`metadata.tensorzero.*`. Cleaner namespace, SDK-friendly, no collision with future Anthropic top-level fields.

## Acceptance

- Decision + rationale recorded
- OpenAI-compat extension-field path (`endpoints/openai_compatible/`) referenced for parity check on which fields must be supported

title: Decide: route paths — /anthropic/v1/messages canonical + /v1/messages alias
description:
Decide the public URL path(s) for Anthropic ingress.

## Options

- `/anthropic/v1/messages` only (consistent with existing `/openai/v1/chat/completions` prefix convention).
- `/v1/messages` only (lets the Anthropic SDK work with no `base_url` override).
- **Both**: `/anthropic/v1/messages` canonical + `/v1/messages` alias (recommended).

## Context

- OpenAI-compat registers routes in `build_openai_compatible_routes()` at `endpoints/openai_compatible/mod.rs:33` and the gateway does `routes.extend(...)` in `gateway/src/routes/external.rs:41`.
- `/v1/messages` as an alias keeps the Anthropic SDK zero-config but collides with potential future top-level versioned routes.

## Recommendation

Support both. Make `/v1/messages` alias disableable via gateway config so operators who proxy multiple APIs can opt out.

## Acceptance

- Chosen path(s) documented
- If the alias is kept, a config toggle is specified and referenced by the route-registration task

title: Decide: promote Anthropic wire types to tensorzero-types-providers
description:
Decide whether to move the existing Anthropic wire types out of `crates/tensorzero-core/src/providers/anthropic.rs` into `crates/tensorzero-types-providers/` (alongside `cache.rs`, `aws_bedrock.rs`, `openai.rs`, etc.) so both outbound and new inbound code can share them, or to keep them provider-local and duplicate as needed for ingress.

## Context

- `providers/AGENTS.md` already states new provider-facing types should live in `tensorzero-types-providers`.
- Current outbound types (`AnthropicRequestBody`, `AnthropicMessage<'a>`, `AnthropicMessageContent<'a>`, `AnthropicStreamMessage`) use borrowed lifetimes — ingress needs owned variants regardless.
- Usage types (`AnthropicUsage`, `AnthropicStopReason`) are already both `Serialize` + `Deserialize` and have no lifetimes; they are prime candidates to move.

## Recommendation

Promote: shared source of truth, aligns with `providers/AGENTS.md`, enables `tensorzero-types-providers/src/cache.rs` to remain the prompt-caching source of truth for this provider.

## Acceptance

- Decision recorded in the ADR body
- Follow-up tasks updated to reference the chosen target crate

title: Phase 2: Streaming E2E tests (Anthropic SDK --stream)
description:
End-to-end streaming tests against the gateway using the official Anthropic SDK.

## Matrix

- Text-only streaming
- Tool-use streaming (single tool)
- Mixed text + tool + text streaming
- Thinking + text streaming (reasoning-capable model)
- Streaming parity: same call via OpenAI-compat streaming vs Anthropic streaming produces equivalent observability rows

## Hermeticism

- Use `provider-proxy` or mock provider to avoid live API costs
- Confirm keepalive `ping` events do not break SDK parsers

## Acceptance

- All matrix rows green
- Gateway closes stream cleanly on underlying provider error

title: Phase 2: SSE framing helper + integrate with messages handler streaming path
description:
Wire the streaming state machine into `messages_handler` and emit proper SSE frames.

## Deliverables

- SSE framing helper that maps `AnthropicStreamMessage` variants to `axum::response::sse::Event` with correct `event:` field (`message_start`, `content_block_start`, `content_block_delta`, `content_block_stop`, `message_delta`, `message_stop`, `ping`, `error`)
- Stream driver: consume `ProviderInferenceResponseStream`, feed chunks to `AnthropicStreamState`, serialize events
- Periodic `ping` keepalive (configurable interval; default ~15–30s, match LiteLLM)
- Mid-stream error path: convert to Anthropic error SSE event and close the stream cleanly

## Acceptance

- `curl -N -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/messages` with `stream: true` emits valid SSE matching Anthropic's spec
- Connection stays alive through `ping` events

title: Phase 2: Chunk-to-event converter + table-driven state-machine tests
description:
Implement `convert_internal_chunk_to_anthropic_events` and its table-driven test suite.

## Scenarios (each row = input chunk list → expected event sequence)

- Text-only stream
- Tool-only stream (one tool call)
- Mixed text + tool_use + text
- Thinking + text (reasoning models, e.g. extended thinking)
- Error mid-stream — must emit a well-formed Anthropic error SSE event
- Empty content then finish
- Multiple tool_use blocks in parallel (if internal model supports it)
- Signature delta arriving separately from thinking delta
- `message_delta` carries final `usage` accumulated across chunks

## Conventions

- `#[gtest]`, `matches_pattern!`, `matches_json_literal!`
- No direct string compare of SSE JSON — parse + `matches_json_literal!`

## Acceptance

- Every scenario has an explicit expected-event fixture
- Tests fail loudly if event ordering invariants break (e.g., missing `content_block_stop` before switching blocks)

title: Phase 2: Streaming state machine (AnthropicStreamState)
description:
Implement the SSE state machine in `endpoints/anthropic_compatible/types/streaming.rs` that re-structures TensorZero's flat `ProviderInferenceResponseStream` chunks into Anthropic's block-oriented event sequence.

## Anthropic event sequence (invariants)

```
message_start           (exactly once, first event)
content_block_start     (one per block, monotonic index)
content_block_delta     (zero or more inside a block; type matches block kind)
content_block_stop      (one per block)
message_delta           (after all blocks closed; carries stop_reason + final usage)
message_stop            (last event)
ping                    (periodic keepalive, anywhere between events)
```

## State

```rust
struct AnthropicStreamState {
    started: bool,
    current_block_index: Option<usize>,
    current_block_kind: Option<BlockKind>,
    tool_id_to_index: HashMap<String, usize>,
    total_blocks: usize,
    aggregated_usage: Usage,
    stop_reason: Option<FinishReason>,
    stop_sequence: Option<String>,
}
```

## Block-switching rules

- Text → ToolUse → Text: close text block, open tool block, close tool block, open new text block (monotonic index)
- Same kind but different tool_id → new block
- Thinking + signature deltas go into same thinking block

## Reference

- LiteLLM's `AnthropicStreamWrapper` at `repos/litellm/litellm/llms/anthropic/experimental_pass_through/adapters/streaming_iterator.py` — read before writing tests

## Acceptance

- Helper `ensure_block` closes/opens correctly across all kind transitions
- `finalize()` emits the required trailing events
- Unit tests in the next task validate behavior

title: Phase 1: E2E + parity tests (Anthropic SDK against gateway)
description:
End-to-end tests under `crates/tensorzero-core/tests/e2e/` using the official `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (Python or TS) against a locally-run gateway (`cargo run-e2e`).

## Matrix

- Basic text: OpenAI-as-underlying + Anthropic-as-underlying
- Tool use (non-streaming)
- System message (string + blocks)
- Multi-turn with tool_result
- Cache-control marker end-to-end (at least on the last user block; per-block requires Phase 3 Input extension)

## Parity sub-suite

- Run the same logical call via `/openai/v1/chat/completions` (with `tensorzero::function_name::X`) and `/anthropic/v1/messages` (same function).
- Assert the resulting `ChatInference` + `ModelInference` rows are equivalent (same function, same variant, same outbound provider request).

## Docker deps

- `docker compose -f crates/tensorzero-core/tests/e2e/docker-compose.yml up` — request the user to run this before invoking E2E tests.

## Acceptance

- All matrix rows pass
- Parity tests pass
- Mock / provider-proxy used where needed for hermeticism

title: Phase 1: Unit tests — Anthropic ingress translation coverage
description:
Rust unit tests (`cargo nextest` + `googletest`) covering Phase 1 translation correctness.

## Coverage

- `try_from_anthropic` round-trip (every `Params` field)
- Content block translation: text / image / document / tool_use / tool_result / thinking / redacted_thinking
- Tool translation: `auto` / `any` / specific / parallel disable / computer-use rejection
- System message variants: plain string vs `Vec<SystemContentBlock>`
- `cache_control` markers preserved through translation
- `tool_choice` enum conversion
- Error mapping (every category in error surface task)
- `msg_<uuid>` ID format

## Conventions

- `#[gtest]`, `expect_that!`, `matches_pattern!`, `matches_json_literal!` per `AGENTS.md`
- `.expect("why")` over `.unwrap()`

## Acceptance

- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` clean

title: Phase 1: Messages handler (non-streaming) — wire Params + inference() + response translation
description:
Implement `messages_handler` in `endpoints/anthropic_compatible/messages.rs`.

## Flow (non-streaming path only; streaming deferred to Phase 2)

1. Deserialize `AnthropicMessagesParams` from request body.
2. Translate to internal `Params` via `Params::try_from_anthropic` (task tensorzero-s4w).
3. Invoke `inference()` with `stream = false`.
4. Translate response via `inference_response_to_anthropic` (task tensorzero-4sa).
5. Return as JSON with correct content-type.

## Observability

- Tag the resulting `ChatInference` row with `ingress=anthropic` (mirror OpenAI-compat tagging).

## Acceptance

- Returns a valid Anthropic-shaped JSON response for simple text calls
- Returns a valid Anthropic error shape on validation errors
- Uses the same `inference()` entry point as OpenAI-compat (no duplication)

title: Phase 1: Anthropic error surface (endpoints/anthropic_compatible/error.rs)
description:
Map internal `Error` to Anthropic error response shape, symmetric to `endpoints/openai_compatible/error.rs`.

## Shape

```json
{"type": "error", "error": {"type": "invalid_request_error", "message": "..."}}
```

## Mapping

| Internal | `error.type` | HTTP |
|----------|---------------|------|
| Authentication | `authentication_error` | 401 |
| Permission / missing scope | `permission_error` | 403 |
| Validation / bad input | `invalid_request_error` | 400 |
| Rate limit | `rate_limit_error` | 429 |
| Provider overloaded | `overloaded_error` | 529 |
| Timeout | `api_error` | 504 |
| Unexpected | `api_error` | 500 |

## Deliverables

- `into_anthropic_error_response()` helper
- `IntoResponse` impl on a dedicated error type (or an existing shared one) that writes the Anthropic shape
- Mid-stream error also emits a well-formed Anthropic error SSE event (Phase 2 may extend)

## Acceptance

- Unit test per row

title: Phase 1: Register Anthropic-compatible routes in gateway
description:
Wire the new `build_anthropic_compatible_routes()` into the gateway router.

## Changes

- `crates/gateway/src/routes/external.rs`: import `build_anthropic_compatible_routes`, extend routes alongside the existing `build_openai_compatible_routes()` call at line ~41.
- Paths per decision tensorzero-62x (recommendation: both `/anthropic/v1/messages` canonical and `/v1/messages` alias).
- Ensure the routes are in the OTEL-enabled set (matching OpenAI-compat).

## Acceptance

- Route appears in `bd show`-style introspection if any (none exists today; skip)

title: Phase 1: Implement inference_response_to_anthropic (response translation)
description:
Translate internal `InferenceResponse` to an Anthropic `/v1/messages` response body.

## Field mapping

| Internal | → Anthropic |
|----------|-------------|
| `inference_id` | `id = format!("msg_{uuid}")` (see decision on ID format) |
| — | `type = "message"`, `role = "assistant"` (constants) |
| `content[]` | Anthropic content blocks (see below) |
| `model_name` / `variant_model_name` | `model` (strip TensorZero prefix) |
| `finish_reason` | `stop_reason` — Stop→EndTurn, Length→MaxTokens, ToolCall→ToolUse, StopSequence→StopSequence, ContentFilter→EndTurn (+tag) |
| `stop_sequence` | passthrough |
| `usage` | see usage translation |

## Content block translation

- `Text { text }` → `Text`
- `ToolUse { id, name, input }` → `ToolUse`
- `Thinking { text, signature }` → `Thinking { thinking, signature }`
- `RedactedThinking { data }` → `RedactedThinking`
- If underlying provider returned `reasoning_content` via OpenAI-adapter: synthesize `Thinking` block with empty signature

## Usage translation

- `input_tokens`, `output_tokens` direct
- `cache_creation_input_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens` only when underlying is Anthropic-family (`None` otherwise); align with `tensorzero-types-providers/src/cache.rs`
- `server_tool_use`, `service_tier` passthrough where applicable

## Acceptance

- Unit tests cover each finish-reason row, each content-block kind, usage with and without cache tokens
- `id` format verified against `@anthropic-ai/sdk` parsing

title: Phase 1: Implement Params::try_from_anthropic (request translation)
description:
Implement the ingress request translation from `AnthropicMessagesParams` to TensorZero internal `Params`, mirroring `Params::try_from_openai` at `endpoints/openai_compatible/types/chat_completions.rs:330`.

## Field mapping

| Anthropic | → `Params` |
|-----------|-------------|
| `model` | `function_name` or `model_name` (parse `tensorzero::function_name::X` / `tensorzero::model_name::X` prefix — same convention as OpenAI-compat) |
| `max_tokens` | `params.chat_completion.max_tokens` (required per Anthropic spec) |
| `messages[]` | `input.messages` — see message translation below |
| `system` | `input.system` (string or blocks) |
| `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k` | `params.chat_completion.*` |
| `stop_sequences` | `params.chat_completion.stop_sequences` |
| `stream` | `stream` |
| `tools[]` | `dynamic_tool_params.tools` (rename `input_schema` → `parameters`) |
| `tool_choice` | `dynamic_tool_params.tool_choice` (+ `disable_parallel_tool_use` → `parallel_tool_calls = false`) |
| `metadata.user_id` | `tags["user_id"]` |
| `service_tier`, `container` | dropped with warning (or extra_headers) |

## Message translation

- `role = user` with `tool_result` blocks → internal tool-result carrier
- `role = assistant` with `tool_use` + `thinking` + text → InputMessage::assistant
- Preserve `cache_control` markers per block (prerequisite task: see `Per-block cache control`)
- Reject computer-use tool entries (`computer_20250124`, etc.) with a clear error in Phase 1
- Consecutive same-role messages: pass through (Anthropic allows; internal Input may or may not — validate)

## Acceptance

- Unit tests round-trip each mapping row
- Tool name preservation verbatim (no 64-char truncation at ingress)
- `tool_choice` conversion table covered

title: Phase 1: Add owned-data Anthropic ingress types
description:
Define the owned-data types needed to deserialize incoming Anthropic `/v1/messages` requests. The existing outbound types (`AnthropicMessage<'a>`, `AnthropicMessageContent<'a>` in `providers/anthropic.rs`) use borrowed lifetimes and are not suitable for Axum request bodies.

## Deliverables

- `AnthropicMessagesParams` — top-level request body: `model`, `messages`, `system`, `max_tokens`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`, `stop_sequences`, `stream`, `tools`, `tool_choice`, `metadata`, `service_tier`, `container`.
- Owned message type (`AnthropicMessageOwned` or similar) with role + content = string OR blocks.
- Content block enum covering: `Text`, `Image`, `Document`, `ToolUse`, `ToolResult`, `Thinking`, `RedactedThinking` — each with optional `cache_control`.
- System type: `String` OR `Vec<SystemContentBlock>` (use `untagged` or custom deserialize).
- Tool + tool_choice types (`auto` / `any` / `tool:{name}` / `none`, plus `disable_parallel_tool_use`).

## Conventions

- Use `TensorZeroDeserialize` for internally-tagged enums without lifetimes (per `AGENTS.md`).
- `#[cfg_attr(feature = "ts-bindings", derive(ts_rs::TS))]` where user-facing.
- `#[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]` + `ts(optional_fields)` on `Option` fields.
- Location driven by decision tensorzero-1wg (type promotion).

## Acceptance

- Types round-trip with representative Anthropic SDK request bodies (captured as test fixtures)
- Unit tests parse: text-only, tool use, tool result, thinking, image, document, cache_control markers, system as string, system as blocks

title: Anthropic /v1/messages ingress for TensorZero gateway
description:
Add Anthropic-compatible inbound API to TensorZero so clients using the official Anthropic SDK (including Claude Code) can route through the gateway without switching to the OpenAI SDK.

Today TensorZero has OpenAI-compatible ingress (`/openai/v1/chat/completions`, `/openai/v1/embeddings`) and native `/inference`. Anthropic is supported **outbound** (calling Anthropic's API from `providers/anthropic.rs`) but not **inbound**. This epic closes that gap.

## Why

- **Anthropic-native clients**: Claude Code and `@anthropic-ai/sdk` users cannot place TensorZero in front today without SDK migration.
- **Prompt caching fidelity**: `cache_control` markers and `cache_creation_input_tokens` / `cache_read_input_tokens` round-trip cleanly via `/v1/messages`; routing through OpenAI-compat is lossy.
- **Tool / thinking blocks**: Anthropic's structured `tool_use` / `tool_result` / `thinking` blocks map imperfectly through OpenAI-compat (flat `tool_calls` + non-standard `reasoning_content`).
- **Observability parity**: Structured observability is currently inaccessible to Anthropic-SDK applications unless they switch SDKs.

## Phase breakdown (see child tasks)

- **Phase 1 — Non-streaming MVP (2–3 weeks)**: types promotion, ingress module, `Params::try_from_anthropic`, `inference_response_to_anthropic`, route registration, error surface, integration + parity tests.
- **Phase 2 — Streaming (1–2 weeks)**: SSE event state machine, chunk → block-oriented event conversion, ping keepalive, streaming E2E.
- **Phase 3 — Polish (1 week)**: `count_tokens` endpoint, `metadata.tensorzero.*` extension fields, per-block cache-control preservation end-to-end, docs, ts-rs bindings.
- **Phase 4 — Advanced (future)**: `/v1/messages/batches` ingress, Anthropic server tools passthrough, cache tokens into observability rows.

## Reference

- Analysis doc: `/home/krystian/Development/ai-tools/doc/analysis/adding-anthropic-api-to-tensorzero.md`
- LiteLLM reference implementation: `repos/litellm/litellm/llms/anthropic/experimental_pass_through/adapters/`
- Anthropic API: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages

## Verified against codebase (2026-04-19)

- `crates/tensorzero-core/src/endpoints/openai_compatible/` layout confirmed (`mod.rs`, `chat_completions.rs`, `embeddings.rs`, `error.rs`, `types/`).
- `build_openai_compatible_routes()` at `endpoints/openai_compatible/mod.rs:33`.
- `Params::try_from_openai` at `endpoints/openai_compatible/types/chat_completions.rs:330`.
- Route registration at `crates/gateway/src/routes/external.rs:41` (`routes.extend(build_openai_compatible_routes().routes)`).
- `crates/tensorzero-types-providers/` exists with `cache.rs` as prompt-caching source of truth (per `providers/AGENTS.md`).
- Anthropic outbound types in `providers/anthropic.rs` use borrowed lifetimes (`AnthropicMessage<'a>`, `AnthropicMessageContent<'a>`) — ingress needs owned variants.

title: Phase 3: Docs + ts-rs bindings for Anthropic ingress

Finalize documentation and TS bindings for the new ingress.

## Docs

- `docs/gateway/ingress/anthropic.md`: endpoint summary, path decisions, example `base_url` override snippets for `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (Python + TS), metadata extension field reference, error codes, streaming notes

## Acceptance

- `pnpm -r typecheck` green
- Bindings committed

title: Phase 3: Per-block cache_control preservation end-to-end
description:
Investigate and then implement per-block `cache_control` support through TensorZero's internal `Input` model so Anthropic ingress can preserve prompt-caching markers losslessly.

## Problem

Anthropic's `cache_control` markers are **per-block** (can appear on any `Text`/`Image`/`Document`/`ToolUse`/`ToolResult` block, and on each `Tool`). Internal `Input.messages[].content[]` likely does not carry `Option<CacheControl>` per block today — verify.

## Investigation

- Grep for `CacheControl`, `cache_control`, `cache_options` in `tensorzero-core`, `tensorzero-types-providers` (especially `cache.rs`).
- Determine today's behavior: do cached tokens survive when the outbound provider is Anthropic? If yes, how is the marker plumbed?
- Scope the blast radius: every provider's input handling touches `Input.content` — extending the struct may touch `openai/`, `anthropic`, `aws_bedrock`, `gcp_vertex_*`, `fireworks`, etc.

## Deliverable

- Spike write-up of current state + proposal
- Follow-up implementation task scoped from the spike

## Acceptance

- Clear path identified (extend `Input` vs. side-channel)
- Cost estimate across providers
- Decision recorded whether this blocks Phase 3 shipping or can ship behind a flag

title: Phase 3: metadata.tensorzero.* extension field lifting
description:
Surface TensorZero's `tensorzero::*`-equivalent extension fields through the Anthropic ingress, per decision tensorzero-k8e.

title: Phase 3: /v1/messages/count_tokens endpoint
description:
Implement `POST /anthropic/v1/messages/count_tokens` (and `/v1/messages/count_tokens` alias if decision tensorzero-62x keeps the alias).

## Request shape

Subset of `/v1/messages`: `model`, `messages`, `system`, `tools`.

## Response shape

```json
{"input_tokens": 1234, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0, "cache_read_input_tokens": 0}
```

## Implementation

- **Option A** (recommended for Phase 3): passthrough to underlying provider's `count_tokens` when the target is Anthropic-family
- For non-Anthropic targets: return `501 Not Implemented` in Phase 1/3, with a feature flag for tiktoken approximation later

## Acceptance

- Anthropic-family underlying: correct counts returned
- Non-Anthropic underlying: 501 with clear error message
- Unit + integration tests

title: Phase 4: Cache tokens as first-class observability (ChatInference.cache_savings)
description: (Deferred.) Wire `cache_read_input_tokens` / `cache_creation_input_tokens` from provider usage into observability rows as a first-class telemetry field (e.g. `ChatInference.cache_savings` or similar). Align with `tensorzero-types-providers/src/cache.rs`. Benefits apply to all providers that report cache tokens, not just Anthropic ingress.

title: Phase 4: Anthropic server tools passthrough (web_search, computer_use)
description:
(Deferred.) Support Anthropic's first-party server tools end-to-end when the underlying provider is Anthropic.

- `web_search`
- `computer_use` / `computer_20250124` et al.
- Any future server tools

Requires internal tool model to accept opaque `type: computer_*` entries without schema and pass them through verbatim to outbound Anthropic.

title: Phase 4: /v1/messages/batches ingress
description:
(Deferred until Phase 1–3 ship.) Add Anthropic's async batch API ingress, tying into TensorZero's existing `start_batch_inference` / `poll_batch_inference` on the provider trait.

## Endpoints

- `POST /anthropic/v1/messages/batches` — submit
- `GET /anthropic/v1/messages/batches/{id}` — poll
- `GET /anthropic/v1/messages/batches/{id}/results` — retrieve (JSONL)
- `POST /anthropic/v1/messages/batches/{id}/cancel` — cancel
- `GET /anthropic/v1/messages/batches` — list

## Dependency

Likely requires a generic batch ingress layer that does not exist yet — this is a larger separate workstream. Scope sub-tasks after Phase 3 lands.
